question: Does an explicit minimum radius give useful control over the smallest forms, and does extending a finite attempt budget visibly fill gaps while retaining the accepted prefix?
decision: Resolve the two remaining control/edit evidence gaps before freezing the seeded placement contract; no continuous recommended ranges or defaults.
hypothesis: Raising the radius floor from4to8 removes the finest rings; extending5000to10000 proposals adds circles in previously empty space while preserving every earlier accepted circle and source-index colour.

baseline.kind: preserved first CP3 private mechanism baseline, not upstream source reproduction

prototype.method: Exact one-occurrence substitution into separate ignored temporary source/build per case. Preserve original source and all prior reports. Compile class SpacingChoice with --release8 against pinned Processing4.5.6 and JDK17. No public code.

variants.isolated_change: minimumRadius4to8; same centre proposals and random units
attempts5000to10000; exact accepted baseline prefix and unchanged source-index colours

comparison: Root and Sol inspect both original new images against the preserved baseline. Record normalized RGB MAE and changed-pixel fraction. Independently regenerate candidate and centre digests, final RNG state and accepted topology via existing Python oracle/checker functions with each exact configuration; match native base-rings profile and before/after retained hashes. Verify 10000 accepted prefix equals original5000 and minimum edit centre digest equals original.

retention_criteria.minimumRadius: Retain as explicit required geometry control if removing the smallest motifs creates an understandable, useful size-floor edit with centre proposals unchanged; do not infer an encouraged continuous range. If unclear, reconsider the convenience size interface before public implementation.
retention_criteria.attempts: Accept continued-filling edit if additional circles visibly occupy gaps without displacing earlier placements, supported by exact accepted-prefix evidence. Retain budget/accounting semantics regardless; no promised output count or density range.
retention_criteria.failure: Preserve failed attempts; no retry or new image without revising and reviewing the investigation.

constraints: Two new images only, one attempt each, in listed order; original five-image experiment is complete and immutable.

limits: Two minimum-radius values and two attempt counts establish inspected configurations only.
The original larger200000 workload remains timing evidence only.
